profile_text.body:
Scite is a for-profit startup founded in 2018 and headquartered in Brooklyn, NY, that describes itself as an AI-powered platform for discovering and evaluating scientific literature. The company says it has indexed more than 1.6 billion citations across more than 300 million scholarly articles, holds licensing agreements with more than 40 publishers plus the full open access corpus, and serves 2 million users worldwide. It is now part of Research Solutions.

The platform's core product, also called Scite, centers on Smart Citations, which show whether later research has supported, challenged, or discussed a given paper, claim, method, journal, author, institution, or funder. An AI Assistant uses the same evidence signals to generate answers grounded in the broader literature, with every claim linked back to the specific sentence in the specific source paper. The company describes this as distinguishing citation-backed answers from responses that require independent re-verification.

The held facts note that Scite operates an MCP server described as allowing users to ground answers in scientific literature, search full text, evaluate trust, and access full-text articles. The site also records a New York law exposure of 220 cases, though no specific litigation details are provided in the available data.
